Creates a delivery: holds its price in your wallet and, unless it is scheduled or dispatched
manually, rings riders at once. Send an Idempotency-Key to retry safely.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique value (e.g. a UUID) so a retry within 24 hours replays the first response.

post.description:
Cancels an order that isn't delivered. Before a rider has it, everything held goes back; once a
rider is on the way, the service charge and the rider's share for the trip so far are charged.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique value (e.g. a UUID) so a retry within 24 hours replays the first response.

200.description: The cancelled order; cancellation shows what was charged.

post.description:
Moves a scheduled order to a new time, or schedules an order still waiting for a rider. The
price and what is held stay the same.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique value (e.g. a UUID) so a retry within 24 hours replays the first response.

post.description:
Rings riders: starts a manual-dispatch order, or rings again for an order still searching (at
most once a minute). Riders are offered the order's fixed price.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique value (e.g. a UUID) so a retry within 24 hours replays the first response.

patch.description:
Changes a stop until the rider completes it. Contact, instructions and package changes apply
at once. Moving a stop (lat, lng and address together) needs a rider: they accept or decline
it, and any extra cost is held from your wallet until they answer.

200.description: The order; a move waiting on the rider shows as the stop's pending_change.

get.description:
Riders' offers on a bidding order (pricing.mode bidding), oldest first. Accept one before it
expires; until then, no rider has your order.

200.description: Every offer riders made on the order, oldest first.

has_more.description: More results follow: pass the last id as starting_after.

post.description:
Gives the order to the rider who made this offer, at their price: you pay the offer plus the
service charge, and the rest of the maximum held goes back to your wallet. Every other open
offer is declined. Only a pending offer can be accepted, and only one accept wins.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique value (e.g. a UUID) so a retry within 24 hours replays the first response.

200.description: The accepted offer. GET the order for its rider.

post.description: Turns an offer down. The rider is told, and may offer again; the order keeps searching.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique value (e.g. a UUID) so a retry within 24 hours replays the first response.

get.description: Where the rider is and when they reach each remaining stop.
No API key: the token is the credential.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The token at the end of a tracking_url.

post.summary: Move a test order along (test keys only)
post.description:
Moves a test-mode order along as a rider would: one step (the test rider accepts, starts,
reaches and completes each stop, then delivers), or straight to `to`. Delivery charges your
test wallet as a live order would. Test keys only.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique value (e.g. a UUID) so a retry within 24 hours replays the first response.

Replaces the signing secret; the new one is shown once. Events are signed with both secrets
for 24 hours, so your receiver can switch over without missing any.

post.description:
Sends a `ping` event to the endpoint now and returns how it went: the status code, the time it
took and the start of the response. Not retried. Check its signature as you would any event.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique value (e.g. a UUID) so a retry within 24 hours replays the first response.

info.title: Pickriders Developer API
info.description: Send and track deliveries with Pickriders: quotes, single, batch, bulk and scheduled orders, rider tracking and webhooks. Authenticate with a secret API key: `sk_test_…` keys use test mode, `sk_live_…` keys use live mode. Guides: https://developers.pickriders.com

tags.name: Ping
tags.description: Check that the Developer API is reachable

tags.name: Status
tags.description: How the platform is doing, with incidents: the data behind the status page

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Your account: profile, verification and live status

tags.name: Wallet
tags.description: Your prefunded wallet: balance, funding and transactions

tags.name: Quotes
tags.description: The price of a delivery before you create it, held for 15 minutes

tags.name: Riders
tags.description: How many riders are near a point, without who or where

tags.name: Service areas
tags.description: Where Pickriders delivers, with the minimum price in each

tags.name: Webhook endpoints
tags.description: Where Pickriders sends events, and the secrets that sign them

tags.name: Events
tags.description: What happened to your orders, wallet and account in the last 30 days

tags.name: Test helpers
tags.description: Test-mode only: play money and simulations for building your integration

ApiKey.description: Your secret API key (sk_test_… or sk_live_…)

ok.description: True when the Developer API is reachable.

status.description: The worst state that day, from incidents.

incidents.description: Incidents not resolved yet, newest first.

recent_incidents.description: Resolved in the last 14 days, newest first.

email_verified.description: Whether the account owner's email is verified.

phone_verified.description: Whether the account owner's phone is verified.

live_status.description: Live mode works only while this is approved. Test mode always works.

livemode.description: true when this request used a live key.

available.description: What the team can spend now: balance minus held. Kobo.

held.description: Reserved for orders in progress. Kobo.

livemode.description: false for the test-mode wallet (play money).

amount.description: Kobo to add to the live wallet (₦50,000 here).

success_url.description: Where the payer lands after paying.

cancel_url.description: Where the payer lands on cancel.

reference.description: The payment reference; the wallet transaction carries it too.

url.description: Send the payer here to pay by card.

balance_after.description: The balance once this transaction landed.

status.description: pending while Paystack checks the BVN.

bvn_last4.description: The last four digits of the BVN it was set up with.

failure_reason.description: Why Paystack could not issue it, when it failed.

amount.description: Kobo to add to the test wallet (₦500,000 here).

id.description: Send this as service_area when you quote or order.

minimum_price.description: The lowest price of a delivery here, in minor units.

rider_search_radius_km.description: How far from a pickup riders are looked for.

phone.description: The person the rider calls at this stop.

value.description: What it is worth, in minor units.

contact.description: Who the rider meets. Required at every drop-off, and at the pickup of a batch. A single or bulk pickup may leave it out: an errand, where the rider buys or collects from a shop with no one to call.

type.description: single: [pickup, drop-off]. batch: [pickup, drop-off, drop-off…] (up to 20). bulk: [pickup, pickup…, drop-off] (up to 20 pickups).

service_area.description: Where the delivery is, from GET /service-areas.

stops.description: In the order the rider visits them.

delivery_fee.description: What the rider is paid for the route.

contact.description: Null at an errand pickup with no one to meet.

id.description: Send it as quote_id when you create the order.

min_price.description: The lowest a rider may offer, when you let riders bid.

max_price.description: The highest a rider may bid (the surge cap).

distance_m.description: Road distance of the whole route, in metres.

duration_s.description: Estimated time from pickup to the last drop-off, in seconds.

usable.description: false once an order has used it, or it has expired.

nearby_count.description: Riders an order from this point would reach now.

at_least.description: True when the count hit the area's search cap: there may be more.

estimated_pickup_s.description: Rough time to pickup, in seconds.

mode.description: fixed: the quote's price; the first rider to accept it takes the order. bidding: riders send offers (GET /orders/{id}/offers) and you accept one.

max_amount.description: Bidding only, and required for it: the most you pay in all (the rider's fee plus the service charge), in kobo. At least the quote's price. Your wallet holds it until you accept an offer.

min_offer_percentage.description: Bidding only: riders can't offer less than this percentage of the quoted delivery fee. Defaults to the service area's floor.

auto_accept_after_s.description: Bidding only: this many seconds after riders are first rung, the lowest standing offer is accepted for you. With no offer by then, the order goes out at the quoted price, as a fixed-price order. Without it, offers wait for you.

auto_advance.description: Move the order along by itself, one step about every 15 seconds, until it is delivered.

scenario.description: Act out a failure as the order is advanced. no_riders: no rider accepts and Pickriders cancels it (failed). rider_cancels: the first rider drops out before pickup and the search starts again. delivery_fails: the rider reaches the first drop-off and the delivery fails (failed, with the trip so far charged).

quote_id.description: A quote from POST /quotes that has not expired or been used. Its stops and price are used.

type.description: Required without quote_id. With one, it must match the quote.

stops.description: Required without quote_id, in the order the rider visits them (see POST /quotes).

scheduled_for.description: Without quote_id, for a scheduled delivery.

reference.description: Your own id for the order, unique per mode. Find the order by it with GET /orders?reference=.

metadata.description: Up to 20 keys of your own (keys up to 40 characters, string values up to 500), returned with the order.

dispatch.description: auto rings riders now (or at the scheduled time). manual waits for POST /orders/{id}/dispatch.

pricing.description: Fixed price unless you choose bidding.

mode.description: fixed: the quote's price. bidding: riders send offers and you accept one (GET /orders/{id}/offers). A bidding order whose auto-accept found no offer becomes fixed: it goes out at the quoted price.

amount.description: What the order costs you: the delivery fee plus the service charge. For bidding, the quoted price until you accept an offer, then the offer plus the service charge.

max_amount.description: Bidding only: the most you pay in all, held in your wallet until you accept an offer.

min_offer_percentage.description: Bidding only: riders can't offer less than this percentage of the quoted delivery fee.

auto_accept_after_s.description: Bidding only: seconds after riders are first rung when the lowest offer is accepted for you.

method.description: confirmation_code: the recipient gave the rider the drop-off's code. rider_confirmed: the rider confirmed a pickup.

location.description: Where the rider was, from the rider app's last reported position.

recipient_name.description: Who handed over or received the package.

extra_amount.description: What the move adds to the price, held until the rider answers.

expires_at.description: If the rider has not answered by then, the move is dropped.

confirmation_code.description: Drop-offs only: the code the recipient gives the rider on delivery. Share it with the recipient.

pending_change.description: A move waiting for the rider to accept (PATCH /orders/{id}/stops/{stop_id}).

tracking_url.description: Drop-offs only: a tracking page for this stop's recipient. It shows no other stop's address.

charged_amount.description: What the cancellation cost you, from what was held: the service charge and the rider share once a rider is on the way.

refunded_amount.description: What went back to your available balance.

number.description: Our order number, shown to riders and support.

reference.description: Your own id for the order, unique per mode.

metadata.description: Your own keys and string values, as you set them on the order.

stops.description: Pickups first, then drop-offs, in route order.

tracking_url.description: A tracking page for the whole order, without addresses or phones. Each drop-off has its own link too.

scheduled_for.description: The new pickup time: at least 1 hour away and at most 30 days ahead.

rating.description: Average rating out of 5; null before any.

completed_trips.description: Deliveries the rider has completed on Pickriders.

status.description: pending: you can accept it until expires_at. declined: you declined it, or accepted another. expired: it lapsed unanswered.

amount.description: What you pay if you accept: the delivery fee plus the service charge.

delivery_fee.description: What the rider asks to be paid.

eta_to_pickup_seconds.description: Roughly how long the rider would take to reach the pickup, from where they last were. Null when that isn't known.

heading.description: Degrees, 0 = north, when the rider app reports it.

updated_at.description: When the rider app last reported this position.

eta_s.description: Seconds until the rider reaches it; null once it is done or while no rider position is known.

rider.description: While a rider has the order and it is not done.

tracking_url.description: The page your customer can open, without an API key.

stop.description: The link's drop-off; null for the order's own link, which shows no addresses.

eta_s.description: Seconds until the rider reaches the link's drop-off, or the next stop for the order's link.

to.description: Keep going until the order reaches this status. Without it, the order takes one step.

url.description: An https URL on the public internet.

enabled_events.description: The events to send, or ["*"] for all of them, including events added later.

disabled_reason.description: Why it is disabled: manual (you turned it off) or failing (every delivery failed for 3 days).

failing_since.description: Since when every delivery has failed. At 3 days the endpoint is turned off.

previous_secret_expires_at.description: After a secret roll, events are signed with the old secret too until this time.

secret.description: Check each event’s Pickriders-Signature with it. Shown only now; store it safely.

disabled_reason.description: Why it is disabled: manual (you turned it off) or failing (every delivery failed for 3 days).

failing_since.description: Since when every delivery has failed. At 3 days the endpoint is turned off.

previous_secret_expires_at.description: After a secret roll, events are signed with the old secret too until this time.

disabled.description: true stops sending events to the endpoint; false starts again.

status_code.description: Null when no response came back.

response_body.description: The first 2 KB of the response.

status.description: pending: waiting for its first try or a retry. failed: retries are over.

next_attempt_at.description: When it is tried next, while pending.

request_body.description: The JSON body sent; null once the event is gone.

object.description: The object the event is about, as it was when the event happened: an order (order.*), a wallet (wallet.*) or your account (account.updated).

stop_id.description: For order.stop.arrived, order.stop.completed and order.picked_up: the stop.

offer.description: For order.offer.created and order.offer.expired: the offer.

transaction.description: For wallet.funded: the credit that funded the wallet. data.object is the wallet after it.

threshold.description: For wallet.balance_low: the threshold the available balance dropped below, in kobo.

type.description: What happened. `ping` comes only from sending a test event to an endpoint.

webhook_endpoint.description: Send only to this endpoint. Without it, every enabled endpoint that receives this event type.

deliveries.description: One new delivery per endpoint, sent at once and retried on failure.
